title: My Parents' Jobs
text:
My mother is a nurse. She works at a big hospital in the city. She helps sick people every day. Her job is important.

My father is a teacher. He works at a school near our house. He teaches math to children. He likes his job very much.

questions.text: How does the writer feel about the parents' jobs?
What can we infer about the mother's work?
options: It takes place only at night
It is not a real job

vocabulary.definition: a person who takes care of sick people in a hospital
a place where sick people receive medical care
a person whose job is to teach students

paragraph_translations: Minha mãe é enfermeira. Ela trabalha em um grande hospital na cidade. Ela ajuda pessoas doentes todos os dias. O trabalho dela é importante.
Meu pai é professor. Ele trabalha em uma escola perto da nossa casa. Ele ensina matemática para as crianças. Ele gosta muito do seu trabalho.
